video.title: Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft Pick 10 - Kevin Durant Build

summary: Josh Lloyd runs a 12-team, 9-category head-to-head mock draft from pick 10, with no third-round reversal. He takes Kevin Durant first, then Jalen Johnson, Trey Murphy, Jaylen Brown, Franz Wagner and Damian Lillard. His top six in order is Jokic, Wembanyama, Doncic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Giannis and Tatum, and he says the middle of round two is a group of interchangeable players. Because he still had no point guard or center later on, he reached for Jarrett Allen and Alex Sarr, then filled in with Zach LaVine, Darius Acuff, John Collins, Ayo Dosunmu, Isaiah Jackson and Aaron Nesmith. Along the way he calls out picks he sees as reaches or values, and he mentions Kings center injuries and two-game playoff weeks. His team projected fourth in the standings.
